description: Battery Data Commons — Curated metadata catalogue for battery datasets

datasets.title: Oxford Battery Degradation Dataset 1
datasets.description: Long-term cycling data for 8 Kokam LiCoO2/graphite pouch cells at multiple temperatures and C-rates. Includes capacity fade, impedance evolution, and full charge/discharge curves over 1000+ cycles.

publications.title: Identifying degradation patterns in lithium-ion batteries

datasets.title: NASA Battery Aging Dataset
datasets.description: Prognostics dataset containing aging data from Li-ion 18650 cells. Batteries were run through charge, discharge, and impedance cycles under varying conditions until end of life.

publications.title: Comparison of prognostic algorithms for battery health monitoring

datasets.title: CALCE Battery Performance Dataset
datasets.description: Comprehensive cycling data for commercial Li-ion cells including capacity degradation, pulse tests, and full performance characterisation under various operating conditions.

datasets.title: Stanford Fast Charging Dataset
datasets.description: High-rate charging protocols tested on commercial cells with lifetime predictions. Contains data from closed-loop optimization of fast-charging protocols.

publications.title: Closed-loop optimization of fast-charging protocols for batteries with machine learning

datasets.title: Sandia Abuse Testing Database
datasets.description: Safety testing data from mechanical, electrical, and thermal abuse tests on commercial Li-ion cells. Includes nail penetration, crush, overcharge, and thermal runaway data.

datasets.title: SNL EV Fleet Telematics Dataset
datasets.description: Field data from electric vehicle battery packs including driving cycles, charging patterns, and state-of-health evolution over multiple years of real-world operation.

datasets.title: Argonne NMC Characterisation Dataset
datasets.description: Electrochemical characterisation data for NMC materials including half-cell and full-cell tests, rate capability, and cycling stability under standardised protocols.

datasets.title: PyBaMM Validation Dataset
datasets.description: Experimental data used for validating the PyBaMM battery modelling framework. Includes GITT, pulse tests, and cycling data matched with simulation outputs.

datasets.title: EIS Degradation Fingerprint Database
datasets.description: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy data tracking degradation modes in commercial Li-ion cells. Includes fitted equivalent circuit parameters and state-of-health correlations.

datasets.title: Na-ion Sodium Layered Oxide Dataset
datasets.description: Performance and cycling data for sodium-ion batteries with layered oxide cathodes. Includes capacity fade, voltage profiles, and rate capability for multiple compositions.

datasets.title: BMW i3 Module Aging Study
datasets.description: Calendar and cycle aging data from automotive battery modules extracted from BMW i3 vehicles. Includes cell-level and module-level measurements with thermal management data.

datasets.title: Thermal Runaway Propagation Dataset
datasets.description: Detailed thermal runaway propagation experiments in battery modules with temperature sensors, gas analysis, and high-speed video correlation.
